45: 7. **Delegation boundary.** Final judgments on theorem correctness, the logical validity of proof steps, and new mathematical claims are reserved to the human. 126: (δf)(X,Y) = (-1)^{p(X)} [X, f(Y)]  −  (-1)^{(p(X)+1)p(Y)} [Y, f(X)]  −  f([X,Y])
